title: Is the AI stock rally still in its early stages?
author: Omegacarlos1
selftext:
I have been paying close attention to AI stocks lately, and it feels like the focus has shifted from AI models themselves to the infrastructure powering them.

A lot of the recent momentum has come from continued spending on semiconductors, data centers and cloud computing as companies expand their AI capabilities.

From a trading perspective, the big question is whether AI stocks still have meaningful upside or if current valuations already reflect most of the growth story. Bulls point to strong infrastructure investment, while bears argue expectations have become too high.

I'm also seeing more investors asking "How to buy AI stocks" and "Where can I buy AI stocks", which suggests interest in the sector remains strong.

Another topic I've been following is 24/7 stock trading. Since major AI news can break outside market hours, it raises an interesting question: Can you trade stocks on weekends, and could continuous trading become more important for AI-focused traders?

For those trading the sector, which area looks most attractive right now: semiconductors, cloud infrastructure, AI software, or robotics?

I've also been tracking AI-related stocks on Bitget, which recently expanded its 24/7 stock trading lineup to 20 stocks, making it easier to react when market-moving news happens outside regular trading hours.
